Kasımpaşa Spor Kulübü, commercially registered as Kasımpaşa Sportif Faaliyetler A.Ş. and commonly referred to simply as Kasımpaşa, is a Turkish professional football club based in the Kasımpaşa neighbourhood, Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, Turkey. Founded in 1921, the club has a long-standing presence in Turkish football and has competed in various divisions of the national league system, spending much of its modern history in the Süper Lig, the highest tier of Turkish football.
